description.value: Kinuseo Cafe is the in-house restaurant of the Tumbler Ridge Inn, a family-run property situated in the heart of the UNESCO Tumbler Ridge Global Geopark in Northern BC. The cafe serves western-inspired comfort food for breakfast, lunch, and dinner daily, and offers packed lunches and delivery service — handy for cyclists heading out on a long day. The inn itself is a hub for outdoor recreation in this remote region, making the cafe a natural resupply and rest stop for touring cyclists passing through.

address.value: 275 Southgate St, Tumbler Ridge, BC V0C 2W0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content confirms Kinuseo Cafe is an active, operating restaurant within the Tumbler Ridge Inn at 275 Southgate St, Tumbler Ridge, BC. The cafe page explicitly calls out 'DELIVERY SERVICE & PACKED LUNCHES AVAILABLE' and a cafe-specific phone number (1-250-242-4625). The inn's About page lists 'Free Wireless Internet' as a property-wide amenity, which extends to the cafe. No bike-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM record has no address or phone; both sourced from website only.

OSM name is 'Kinuseo Cafe & Dining Room' but the website heading uses the shorter 'Kinuseo Cafe'; the inn About page spells it 'Kinueso Cafe & Dining Room' (possible typo). OSM name retained as instructed.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, publicly accessible restaurant within a functioning inn in a remote Northern BC community; confirmed open with current website content and useful amenities (packed lunches) for touring cyclists.
